errors.description: Model incorrectly identified the front face color of the reference cube as green, when the ground truth explicitly states it is red. This misperception led to an incorrect matching process.
errors.evidence_quote: Model trace: 'Front face: green' — contradicts Ground Truth: 'Front: red'

analysis_result.analysis: Although the model arrived at the correct final answer (D), it did so based on a fundamentally incorrect perception of the reference cube’s front face color. The ground truth clearly states the front face is red, but the model claims it is green. This misperception should have led to rejecting Option D (which has a green front face) and selecting Option C (which has a red front face). The fact that the model still chose D suggests it either misread the options or made a compensating error. This is a critical perception failure that undermines the validity of the reasoning, even if the final answer coincidentally matches.
